summary: Experimental Adaptive Touch in BR Brain with private local aggregate learning.

changes.title: Adaptive Touch (experimental)
changes.detail: Opt-in letter boundary adjustment learns from explicitly chosen tap suggestions. Centered taps and swipe typing retain their existing path.

changes.title: Private touch learning
changes.detail: Only bounded layout-level offset aggregates are encrypted locally. Transient touch proof expires; protected editors are excluded. No new internet permission.

changes.title: Learning controls
changes.detail: BR Brain includes an experimental switch and an explicit reset for touch-offset models.

changes.title: Storage compatibility
changes.detail: Use the existing app credential-protected no-backup context and reject device-protected storage; no plaintext fallback.
